subsetPolicyRationale: `s.puzzle.3d@1` is this plugin's own self-contained 3D puzzle document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-object, delete-object, move-object, rotate-object, scale-object, change-object-mesh, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
